sources.title: Solomon Islands Gazette Legal Notice No. 128: concessional entry arrangement countries
sources.officialityEvidence: The live PDF is an Extraordinary Gazette published on the Solomon Islands Government's solomons.gov.sb domain and identifies Legal Notice No. 128 under the Immigration Act 2012.
sources.supportingExcerpt: NOTICE OF CONCESSIONAL ENTRY ARRANGEMENT COUNTRIES

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division Delivery Policy: Short Term Visa
sources.officialityEvidence: The current policy PDF is linked from the Immigration Division's official resource page on immigration.gov.sb and identifies the Division, Director, and Ministry.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Lodge application via the electronic visa portal on the Solomon Islands Immigration websites.

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division: Visas
sources.officialityEvidence: This is the Division's live visa page on immigration.gov.sb, which identifies the responsible Ministry and links its eVisa service.
sources.supportingExcerpt: ONLINE PAYMENT AND APPLICATION IS NOW OPERATIONAL.

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division: Visitor Visa – Tourist
sources.officialityEvidence: The live tourist-visa page is published by the Immigration Division on immigration.gov.sb and identifies the Ministry contact details.
sources.supportingExcerpt: You may be given 'visa on arrival' for 30 days.

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division: Visa Online Application Notice
sources.officialityEvidence: The notice is a current public Immigration Division page on immigration.gov.sb and bears the Division's official contact and Ministry identity.
sources.supportingExcerpt: all visa applications must be submitted using manual application forms and processed in person

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division: Division Resources
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Immigration Division resource page on immigration.gov.sb links the Act, Regulations, portal policies, forms, and the eVisa login.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Some applications may still require physical submission or interview attendance.

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division linked eVisa portal
sources.officialityEvidence: The live immigration.gov.sb visa and resource pages label this exact immigration.sig.gov.sb hostname as the official eVisa Login; on 2026-08-21 its root returned the generic IIS landing page rather than an application service.

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Act 2012
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Immigration Division resource page links this Act PDF and describes it as governing non-citizens' entry, stay, and exit.

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Regulations 2013
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Immigration Division resource page links this Regulations PDF and describes it as procedures and visa conditions under the Immigration Act 2012.
